description: This file is a test script for validating the integrity of manpages related to libcurl, checking for syntax issues like unbalanced formatting commands, missing references, and non-existing pages. It scans specific directories for man page files and reports any errors or inconsistencies.

methods.name: manpresent
methods.description: Checks if a specific man page exists in the provided documentation root directory.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Analyzes a given file for syntax errors related to manpage formatting and references.
